name: Adaptive Triangle-to-Voxel Overlap Test
definition: A voxelization algorithm that determines which grid voxels overlap with a triangle by classifying the triangle's bounding box thickness into three cases (1D, 2D, or 3D) to optimize the overlap test.
summary: The Adaptive Triangle-to-Voxel Overlap Test is a voxelization algorithm that classifies bounding box thickness to skip geometric tests for thin boxes, optimizing overlap detection.
